label: Polynomial class identifiability and coordinate controls
paraphrase: Over every commutative integral domain, evaluation on distinct samples identifies coefficient polynomials of natDegree at most d iff sample cardinality exceeds d. A monic sample product produces agreement and divergence at any supplied fresh point, including empty data. Nonzero affine input substitution preserves degree. Rational polynomials agree at 0 through 3 and predict 16 versus 40 at 4. The real coordinate x+x cubed is bijective and changes the displayed law degree from three to one. No compatibility existence, actual law, coordinate warrant, or root truth is asserted.
